topics: Introduction to microprocessors - Features and Architecture of 8085
8085 Pin diagram- Pins, Signals and functions
Assembly language programming- Basic Instruction set to write Simple programs - Arithmetic, Logical, Branching instructions, Opcodes, hand coding
Programs involving 8 and 16bit Addition, Subtraction, Memory Reading and writing, Sorting
Machine cycles, instruction cycle and T states
Introduction to Embedded Systems -Application domain, features and characteristics, Microprocessors and Micro controllers– Choice and suitability for applications
Introduction to Arduino UNO(8bit)- Hardware fundamentals of ATmega328Pmicrocontroller based Board.
Arduino Architecture, Pin diagram and functions of Pins- Overview of main features such as I/O Ports, Timers, interrupts, PWM, ADC (Introduction only).
Introduction to Arduino IDE- Arduino Libraries, Steps for creating an Arduino program- Arduino Sketch Structure and Flow- Setup and loop functions.
Programming in Embedded C. Data types- operators, conditional statements- Loops, Arrays and functions- Built in functions in Arduino
Program to blink an LED and its control., Interfacing LCD, Seven Segment LED, switch Interface, Binary counter
Working with LED Controlled by Switch/ Potentiometer, Interfacing with Relays, Buzzer, Working with Basic sensors and actuators using Arduino.

ARM (Advanced RISC Machines) based Embedded System Design : Classification of Microprocessors based on the word length, architecture and  Instruction Set-  Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC) and Complex Instruction Set Computer (CISC).

Introduction to Arduino due(32bit) - micro controller board (based on the atmel sam3x-- arm cortex- m3 cpu)- Features, General Specifications Overview, General architecture- Features OF Microcontroller, INPUTS,OUTPUTS, Ratings, Functional Overview, Pinout- familiarization of the ports of the board.
Programming Basics- Arduino IDE-Use of Timer, Interfacing of ADC and DAC

partA.description: 2 Questions from each module. Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description: Each question carries 9 marks. Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: Describe the architecture of 8085 microprocessor and 8085 Assembly language programming.
Understand the need for interrupts, Subroutines, timing diagram of 8085 microprocessor and interfacing
Understand and gain the basic idea about the embedded system and selection of processors.
Able to gain working level knowledge about a Arduino Uno based system architecture and Arduino IDE
Write Programs using Embedded C and implement an application using Arduino UNO board.
Understand the RISC Architecture and Apply  the knowledge for solving the real life problems using ARM - Arduino DUE board based embedded system.
